purpose: A Webflow background-video block. Three instances, all in the .ai video showcase.

props.poster: the SAME mp4 path is used as the poster attribute and as the .video-poster background-image - the source has no separate poster still

attributes: playsInline, webkit-playsinline, muted, loop, preload="none", data-autoplay="true", data-poster, poster, plus a <source type="video/mp4" data-src>
behaviour: public/motion/m27.js drives these. It reads prefers-reduced-motion AND navigator.connection.saveData, forces muted/playsInline/loop/preload=none, copies data-poster onto the poster attribute and onto .video-poster's background-image, and fades the poster out via .video-faded when playback starts.

reducedMotion.detail: This is the ONLY slot in the project whose reduced-motion behaviour is real, observed behaviour rather than a design rule this repository prescribes. m27.js is the only script in src/ or public/motion/ that reads the media query, and no stylesheet contains a prefers-reduced-motion rule.

responsive.base: three clips: one in .ai__grid-small-left, one in .ai__grid-small-lg, one in .ai__grid-small-right

allowedAssetRolesNote: Machine-checkable list of the assetRole ids this contract may carry, replacing the prose it previously held ('showcase-video (closed to this one role)'). extraction/verify_all.py check [j] resolves every string under an assetRole key against the closed registry, so a prose sentence there would be - and was - reported as an unlisted role.
